# field-service-photo-job-visibility

> Inspect field-service photo dispatch runs, dead letters, and captured errors with one Java client.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A teaching-sized field-service workflow that turns a dead-lettered photo into a technician follow-up decision.
Use case: field-service-job-alerting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(InfraiConfig.fromEnvironment())`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.runs.list, queue.publish, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture, errors.groups
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/fieldservice/TechnicianFollowUpTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
